product: Marketed: CFTR modulators TRIKAFTA and ALYFTREK, CASGEVY gene therapy for sickle cell disease and transfusion-dependent beta thalassemia, JOURNAVX suzetrigine for moderate-to-severe acute pain. Added via Crinetics: PALSONIFY paltusotine for acromegaly and atumelnant. Pipeline: povetacicept for IgA nephropathy and inaxaplin for APOL1-mediated kidney disease.
demand: Strong. Q2 2026 revenue of $3.33B rose 12% on continued CF patient demand and ALYFTREK new initiations, higher CASGEVY infusions, and JOURNAVX launch. Non-CF product revenue is guided to $500M or more for full-year 2026.
pricing_power: Meaningful in cystic fibrosis: US growth included higher realized net prices versus the prior year. Povetacicept targets high unmet need in IgAN with differentiated every-4-week low-volume autoinjector dosing, which supports pricing in a new franchise.
competition: Intense and broadening: CF rivals whose data Vertex called less concerning than feared, multiple competing IgAN and nephrology programs, opioid and other acute-pain alternatives against JOURNAVX, and acromegaly incumbents Ipsen and Novartis facing PALSONIFY.
team: Reshma Kewalramani is CEO and President; Carmen Bozic is Chief Medical Officer; Nia Tatsis is Chief Regulatory and Quality Officer. Charles Wagner expanded his COO role to lead Crinetics integration; Jonathan Poole becomes CFO Jan 1, 2027; Jasper van Grunsven joined Sep 8, 2026.
market_strategy: Diversify beyond cystic fibrosis into five pillars by 2027: CF, hematology, acute pain, renal and rare endocrine. Build a launch-ready nephrology sales force for povetacicept, and use acquisitions such as Crinetics to accelerate revenue growth and the long-term earnings profile.
bull: Q2 2026 revenue $3.33B rose 12% YoY with FY guidance raised to $13.1-13.2B (Aug 3, 2026); povetacicept PDUFA Nov 30, 2026 and positive inaxaplin Phase 2b (Sep 22, 2026) add two new franchises.
bear: Q2 EPS $4.73 missed $4.74 consensus; FY2026 EPS projected to fall to $16.17 from $18.40; gross margin slipped 1.5pts; P/E near 30 leaves little room for disappointment.
falsifier: FDA rejects or delays the povetacicept BLA on or before its Nov 30, 2026 PDUFA date, removing the renal-franchise launch that underpins the five-pillar thesis.
web_what_changed: Q2 2026 revenue $3.33B, up 12% YoY, with FY guidance raised to $13.1-13.2B (Aug 3, 2026). Completed ~$10.0B Crinetics acquisition Sep 1, 2026, adding PALSONIFY and atumelnant as a fifth pillar. Positive Phase 2b AMPLIFIED inaxaplin data Sep 22, 2026. FDA widened CASGEVY to ages 2+ Jul 1, 2026. Povetacicept PDUFA Nov 30, 2026.
web_not_known_yesterday: As of Sep 25, 2026 the newest disclosure was Sep 22, 2026: positive Phase 2b AMPLIFIED inaxaplin results (UACR -42.7% modest proteinuria cohort, -17.3% type 2 diabetes cohort) plus completed AMPLITUDE enrollment, interim analysis early 2027 that could support US accelerated approval. Nothing newer appeared dated Sep 24.
web_demand_price_volume_mix: Demand-led with a price component: US revenue rose 11% to $2.06B on strong CF patient demand including ALYFTREK initiations plus higher realized net CF prices, and CASGEVY and JOURNAVX contributions. Ex-US rose 14% to $1.28B on CF uptake, more CASGEVY infusions and favorable FX. So volume/demand plus price and FX mix.

Vertex noted competitor CF data proved less concerning than feared (Wells Fargo session, Sep 9, 2026).

Insider selling by Carmen Bozic and Ourania Tatsis. Short interest rose to 4.66M shares as of Aug 31, 2026. Canaccord Genuity holds with $442 target, below price (Sep 23, 2026).
web_if_management_right: Povetacicept launches as the first renal-franchise therapy after the Nov 30, 2026 PDUFA; inaxaplin AMPLITUDE interim turns positive in early 2027; PALSONIFY and atumelnant scale toward $5B or more combined peak. FY2026 revenue lands at $13.1-13.2B, five pillars by 2027, Crinetics accretive to non-GAAP operating income in 2029.
web_if_management_wrong: Crinetics integration plus renal-launch spending compress margins and EPS first, with accounting impacts detailed on the Nov 2, 2026 earnings call. If AMPLITUDE or myotonic dystrophy type 1 data miss, the renal and pipeline premium erodes while CF pricing and reimbursement pressure bites. A roughly 30x P/E leaves little room for disappointment.
